limitations: Service review parent remains partial: native service dropdown replaces Qt local/remote/type notebook; descriptions, deleted-file-record clear and remote service/account/IPFS controls excluded.

Rust model/store/native regressions authored; root hosted CI remains pending. No local Cargo build, test or mutation test executed.

claims.exactBehavior: Like/dislike, numerical and inc/dec review exposes for deleted files / for all non-local files / for all files. Exact do it / forget it questions and warnings apply captured service only; owned cancel/replacement/retired callbacks cannot write. Deleted uses physical-storage deleted records; non-local uses absence from physical storage, so trash remains local. Content transaction clears the correct ratings table and preserves other services; counts survive store/UI reopen.
